## 1. What the project already decided nav should contain

**Canonical spec:** `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\obsidian\07-UX\Navigation-Footer-Spec.md` (Proposed; implemented in config + layout).

**Desktop header**
- Logo → `/` (no Home item)
- Nav: **Services** (mega) | **Case Studies** | **About** | **Blog** | **Contact**
- CTA button: **Free Audit** → `/free-audit-2/`
- Sticky header; optional top announcement bar (Olifant/Sequence pattern)

**Mega menu (3 columns, Olifant-style)**
- Col 1 Core / Col 2 Other / Col 3 CTA panel (“Not sure what you need?” + Get Free Audit + phone)

**Exclude from primary nav:** Home, Testimonials, Who We Are, News, Other Services as top-level (merged into About / Blog / mega Col 2)

**Footer:** Pre-footer CTA band + 4 columns (Brand / Core Services / Company / Contact) + legal (Privacy, Terms)

**Implemented config mirror:** `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\content\config\navigation.json`

---

## 2. Competitor mega menu patterns documented

| Agency | Nav pattern | Source |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| **Olifant Digital** (primary) | Top bar + mega dropdown with **inline CTA panel** + “Free marketing plan” sticky CTA | Design-Inspiration, Competitor-Analysis, COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH |
| **Sequence Commerce** | Awards strip + multi-level services mega + “Free audit” | Same |
| **AMZ Dudes** | Simple horizontal + modal CTA + phone (not mega) | Same |
| **Canopy** | Clean horizontal + services dropdown + “Talk with expert” | Same |
| **MAG** | Standard dropdown + “Free listing audit” | Same |

**eCom Gliders target:** Tier B (Olifant) mega + CTA panel + Tier C (AMZ Dudes) sticky header CTA.

Screenshots: `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\backup\research\competitors\`

---

## 3. Service taxonomy that should appear in nav

**Planned (new site mega / footer):**

**Core (6):** Amazon Account Management → `/full-service-amazon-agency/`; PPC → `/amazon-ppc-management-agency/`; Listing Optimization and SEO; Content Writing; Visual Creativity; Catalog Management  
*(last four use proposed slugs like `/amazon-listing-optimization/`, etc. in `navigation.json`)*

**Other (4):** Company Registration; Trademark and Brand Registry; Website SEO and Development; DSP Platforms

**Old live site taxonomy** (`backup/pages/homepage.html`) differed:

- **All Services:** PPC (typo “Advertisment”), Full Account Management, Content Writing, CTR Improvement, Search Ranking Optimizations, Catalog, Product Sourcing & Shiping (typo), Reporting & Analytics — mostly `#service_*` anchors on `/services/`
- **Other Services:** Company Registration, Product Email marketing, Trademark USPTO, Brand Registry, Website SEO, Website Development, Video Editing, DSP — mostly `#services_*` on `/services-2/`

**Planned changes vs old:** drop CTR / Sourcing / Reporting / Email / Video as nav items (or fold elsewhere); merge Trademark + Brand Registry; merge Website SEO + Development; rename SEO to Listing Optimization; fix typos; dedicated page URLs only.

---

## 4. Gaps: planned nav vs implemented

| Area | Status |
|------|--------|
| Header IA + Free Audit CTA + sticky | **Done** (P1-07) |
| 3-col mega menu + CTA panel | **Done** |
| Mobile sheet + Services accordion | **Done** (P1-09) |
| Footer 4-col + pre-footer | **Done** (P1-08) |
| Blog in primary nav | **Done** (was missing on old site) |
| Announcement bar | **Component exists; disabled** in `site.json` (`enabled: false`) |
| Service destination pages | **Gap:** only `content/config/services/amazon-ppc-management-agency.json` exists. Mega links to full-service + 8 proposed paths have **no** service JSON yet → 404 or blog collision risk |
| `/full-service-amazon-agency/` | Preserved URL in SEO map; **no service config file verified** |
| Old-site items not in new nav | CTR, Sourcing, Reporting, Email, Video — intentional drop; confirm no SEO redirect plan |
| Spec status | Navigation-Footer-Spec still says “Proposed / pending approval” while build marked P1-05–09 DONE |
| `Current-Site-Audit.md` | Still “Not started”; old nav detail lives in backup HTML + COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH instead |
